posts.title: When to use a decision model instead of an LLM
posts.description: Artificial Analysis just benchmarked decision models against LLMs. Split by task, the results show where decision models win and where an LLM is still worth paying for.

posts.title: My optimal road trip maps are back
posts.description: I brought my 2015 road trip project back with restored maps, new landmark and national park routes, and a free builder for choosing your own stops.

posts.title: The people who use AI the most are also the most worried about it
posts.description: Pew's 2026 data shows the youngest U.S. adults use AI chatbots the most, yet they are also the most likely to expect AI to harm society.
